title: DCF gene finder and nerve-chemistry tools: label-free gene calling and metal-class annotation
description: Label-free period-3 gene finder with genetic-code detection, the ferredoxin-ladder redox profiler, and the nerve-chemistry tools (dcf_nerve, dcf_pump, dcf_neurometal, dcf_k2p) used in the Digital Cosmos Framework pre-registered tests. Not for medical use.
